name: config
label: Datagrid Configuration
description: An object with properties to configure the grid

name: toolbar
label: Toolbar Configuration
description: An object with properties to configure the toolbar placement and options

name: columns
label: Datagrid Columns
description: An array of column objects that describe each column header in the grid

name: tasks
label: Tasks List
description: An array of task objects that displays rows in the grid

name: stickyRows
label: Sticky Rows
description: An array of sticky rows objects that displays as fixed rows in the grid

name: sortBy
label: sort column name and order
description: An object to sort the column with the order

name: multiGridConfig
label: Multi grid config
description: Multi Grid configuration to enable drag and drop across multiple grids.

name: defaultFilter
label: Apply default filter on grid on load
description: An encoded query to filter grid on load

name: groupBy
label: Group by
description: An array of column names to apply the group by in order

name: pagination
label: Datagrid server side pagination config
description: An object to set the page number, records limit

name: borderStyle
label: Border Style Configuration
description: A string to set the border style type

name: reorderRowIconTitle
label: Title for Reorder Row Icons
description: A String to show as title for rearranging icons

name: defaultCommentTooltip
label: Default tooltip when user hover on comment icon
description: Default tooltip when user hover on comment icon

name: manageReorderRows
label: Manage Reorder Rows Feature
description: Control the enabling/disabling of rearranging icons.

name: enableTextWrapping
label: Enable text Wrapping for Grid
description: Enable text Wrapping for Grid.

name: enableAutoFocus
label: Enable auto focus
description: Enable auto-focussing of last focussed cell upon re-rendering.

name: textWrapping
label: Show wrapped text
description: Show wrapped text.

name: textWrappingLineClamp
label: Truncates text at line number
description: Truncates text at line number.

name: manageCompactMode
label: Manage compact mode
description: Manage compact mode using toggle.

name: compactMode
label: Compact mode
description: Compact mode.

name: enableColumnSmartRendering
label: Enable column smart rendering
description: Enable column smart rendering.

name: disableReorderRows
label: Disable Reorder Rows Icons
description: Manage the enabling/disabling of rearranging icons.

name: groupingOrder
label: Grouping Order
description: Change sorting order of the column, when grouping action is performed

name: manageColumnShowHide
label: Manage column show/hide
description: Manage loading of tasks on hide and show of columns.

name: displayChildTasksCount
label: Display child node count
description: Show and hide the child nodes count

name: showSidePanel
label: Show Side Panel
description: Show and hide the side panel

name: selectedSidePanel
label: Selected side panel to open
description: Provide the side panel id to open the side panel.

name: sidePanelSize
label: Size of side panel
description: Set the size of the side panel to small, medium or large

name: disableRowSelectionCheckbox
label: Disable row selection checkbox icons
description: Manage the enabling/disabling of row selection checkbox icons.

name: customLegendItems
label: Custom legend items to be shown in legend panel
description: Manage the list of custom legend items to be shown in legend sidepanel.

name: rowContextMenuItems
label: Row Context Menu Items
description: Context menu choices that will be displayed on the task row

name: cellContextMenuItems
label: Cell Context Menu Items
description: Context menu options that will be displayed on cells

name: groupColumnLabel
label: Group Column Label
description: Label for group column (visible on applying grouping on any column)

name: customAggregateRow
label: Custom Aggregate Row
description: Custom Aggregation Row for bottom of grid

name: manageColumnPersonalization
label: Manage column personalization
description: Manage display of datagrid's side panel when Personalize columns action is clicked.

name: enableAddColumn
label: Enable add column
description: Allow user to add new column

name: addColumnConfig
label: Add column configuration
description: Allowed list of column types to be added as new column

name: gridStyle
label: Grid Style Configuration
description: Define the style of the grid. For example, provide height and min-height to the grid.

name: rowStyleConfig
label: Row Level Style Config
description: Row level style configuration that applies specific styles to parent, leaf, and dynamically indexed rows.

name: newInlineTask
label: New task to be added inline
description: An object to render task in edit mode at any specific position

name: enableExport
label: Enable export
description: Enable export of grid data in CSV or Excel format

name: exportFileName
label: Exported file name
description: Define the name of the exported file

name: dataDisplayMode
label: Data display mode
description: Define data display mode for the grid

name: includeChildrenInFilter
label: Include children in filter
description: When enabled, filtering will include child records of visible parents, even if those children don't meet filter criteria. Only applies when filter operations are performed.
